crossRefs.note: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
“ ‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every…
This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything…
“This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest,
This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.
This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,
“ ‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,
“ ‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of…
“This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be…
“This is the law of the house. On the top of the mountain the whole limit around it shall be most holy. Behold, this is…

translations.web: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;
translations.bsb: This is the law of him who has a discharge, of the man who has an emission of semen whereby he is unclean,
translations.kjv: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled
translations.asv: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed of copulation goeth from him, so that he is unclean thereby;
